scope: Web application contract for A02U only. It authorizes the corpse, summon, and reward-origin behavior required by SP-10-09-c through h; it does not implement them.

source.mapEvidence: sp10_09_ordinary_summon_evidence.json: A02U inherits ACrD; Rai1=1, Rai3=n016, Raiu=n016, acdn=3.
source.externalBaseline: Classic Warcraft III Raise Dead documentation: skeleton timed life is 40 seconds. The map does not override timed life.

ability.suppressedInheritedGroups: Do not create an unverified Rai2/Rai4 group until source base-object values are recovered.

corpse.eligible: An accepted active-run death event for a non-summoned runtime enemy with the same hostile owner as the caster.
corpse.selection: Nearest eligible unreserved corpse; distance tie-breaks by deathSequence.
corpse.reservation: Reserve before cooldown commitment. The reservation identifies the original death key and is released if casting cannot resolve.
corpse.consumption: Consume only after the runtime skeleton entity and gameplay summon registry have both accepted the creation.

summon.spawn: Spawn at the consumed corpse position or the nearest passable candidate determined by SP-10-09-g. Never fall back to a wave entrance.

cap.onReached: Reject the cast without consuming the corpse or advancing cooldown.

summon.parentRemoval: The skeleton remains after the Soulstealer parent dies or is removed; it ends only by accepted combat death, timed-life expiry, run disposal, or explicit external removal.
summon.recursion: skeleton_warrior has no A02U and cannot make corpses eligible for A02U.

rewardOrigin.owner: Inherit ownerPlayerId from the Soulstealer parent.
rewardOrigin.ledger: Record normal combat death identity for observability, but mark skeleton_warrior as reward-ineligible for score, wallet, farmer XP, drops, and level entitlements.
rewardOrigin.basis: SP-10-02 provides no direct reward evidence for regular-enemy or summoned skeleton deaths; this prevents a summon loop from creating a reward source.
rewardOrigin.boundary: SP-10-17 through 21 own ledger writes and must consume this origin flag.

transitionCases.cast: one reservation wins by first accepted transition
transitionCases.summon: one or none if spawn fails
removed with expired reason and no reward
accepted combat death, no score/wallet/XP/drop entitlement

implementationBoundaries.SP-10-09-c: Pure corpse reservation and consumption state.
implementationBoundaries.SP-10-09-f: Gameplay cap, termination, and reward-origin registry.
implementationBoundaries.SP-10-09-h: A02U target selection and shared clock execution.
